target_audience.primary_persona: Norwegian municipal administrators (kommune staff) who manage public resource bookings, listings, and citizen services
secondary_personas: Norwegian citizens booking municipal facilities and resources
System administrators managing multi-tenant municipal deployments
Municipal IT departments integrating with existing infrastructure
Auditors requiring compliance verification and audit trail access
pain_points: Fragmented booking systems across different municipal departments
GDPR compliance challenges with citizen data management
Lack of audit trails for regulatory compliance
Poor multi-tenant isolation in existing solutions
Inadequate mobile experience for citizen self-service
No centralized notification system across communication channels
Complex permission management across organizational roles
goals: Centralized booking and resource management for all municipal facilities
Full GDPR compliance with consent management and data subject rights
Complete audit trails for all mutations and administrative actions
Real-time availability updates and booking notifications
Role-based access control matching municipal organizational structure
Norwegian language support with Norwegian Design System compliance
target_audience.usage_context: Daily use by municipal staff managing bookings/listings from backoffice portal, and intermittent use by citizens via public web app and user portal (minside) for discovering facilities, making bookings, and managing their profiles

product_vision.one_liner: A production-ready Norwegian municipal booking and resource management platform with multi-tenant isolation, GDPR compliance, and audit-first architecture
product_vision.problem_statement: Norwegian municipalities struggle with fragmented, non-compliant booking systems that lack proper audit trails, GDPR compliance, and multi-tenant isolation for managing public resources and citizen services
product_vision.value_proposition: Provides a complete, enterprise-grade booking platform built on Norwegian Design System (Designsystemet) with built-in GDPR compliance, comprehensive audit logging, real-time WebSocket updates, and strict architectural patterns that ensure code quality and compliance across multiple municipal deployments
success_metrics: Number of municipalities (kommuner) actively using the platform
Booking completion rate across all listing types
GDPR compliance audit pass rate (100% required)
Average response time for API endpoints (<200ms)
User satisfaction scores from municipal staff and citizens
Audit trail completeness (100% of mutations logged)

existing_features: Multi-tenant architecture with kommune-level isolation
Authentication via ID-porten (Norwegian digital identity)
Role-based access control (RBAC) with capability-based guards
Listing/facility management with availability calendar
Booking system with recurring booking support
GDPR consent management and data subject request handling
Multi-channel notification system (in-app, email, SMS, push)
Real-time WebSocket updates for availability and notifications
Audit logging for all state mutations
Enterprise SDK with 30+ services and React Query hooks
Norwegian Design System facade (@xala/ds) with theme switching
Internationalization (Norwegian/English) via @xala/i18n
Discount code management
Dashboard with KPI reporting
Integration framework for third-party services
GraphQL API via Mercurius
Health checks and monitoring endpoints
Backoffice admin portal with comprehensive management features
User portal (minside) for citizen self-service
Public web app for listing discovery and booking initiation
known_gaps: Social sharing for listings (TODO in ListingsPage)
Season management SDK hooks incomplete (multiple TODOs)
Linear issue tracking integration not implemented
Rental objects feature temporarily disabled due to export issues
Global search via SDK not implemented in minside header
Season application SDK hooks need completion
User info enrichment in notification service
technical_debt: Rental-objects feature disabled in backoffice App.tsx due to export issues
Some season-related routes using mock data instead of SDK
Notification service missing user info enrichment from user service
Type breakdown and priority breakdown in notification stats not implemented
Some components have placeholder onClick handlers

alternatives: Norwegian-specific: FRI Utvikling, Spond (limited municipal features)
differentiators: Built on official Norwegian Design System (Designsystemet) for government compliance
Native multi-tenant architecture with kommune-level data isolation
GDPR-first design with built-in consent management and Article 30 compliance
Complete audit trails meeting Norwegian regulatory requirements
ID-porten integration for national digital identity
Enterprise SDK pattern ensuring code quality and maintainability
Real-time WebSocket updates for availability and notifications
RFC 7807 compliant error handling throughout the platform
Strict architectural guardrails enforced via ESLint rules
competitive_context.market_position: Purpose-built solution for Norwegian municipalities seeking a modern, compliant, and maintainable booking platform that integrates with national digital infrastructure (ID-porten) and follows government design standards

technical: Must use @xala/ds facade for all UI components (no direct Designsystemet imports)
All API calls must go through @digilist/client-sdk (no direct fetch/axios)
All errors must follow RFC 7807 Problem Details format
All mutations must be auditable (audit-first principle)
Must maintain multi-tenant isolation at all layers
TypeScript strict mode required throughout codebase
pnpm workspaces with Turborepo for monorepo management
resources: Must maintain production system while developing new features
Limited capacity for major architectural changes
Documentation and testing must be maintained alongside development
